messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick flag: Neptune Analytics (acct: neptune-analytics) ramped up embeddings this morning after enabling the new search pipeline. Their upcoming QBR is Friday 10. Cost is spiking, want to triage before the meeting.
Aidan (FinOps): How big is the spike? Any idea which endpoint?
Rosa (SWE): From the traces it's the `/v1/embeddings/batch` route. 48h delta +420k tokens, 80% of requests from a handful of pipeline workers that reprocessed old docs. Looks like parallel workers lack idempotency and are resubmitting chunks. SDK in use: python-sdk v1.2.3.
alert-bot: Alert: high-cost-embeddings detected for neptune-analytics 2026-04-05T07:11:02Z delta +422400 tokens.
Priya (CSM): Can Ops put a soft cap on embeddings for their prod org while we work the root cause? Prefer not to break search but avoid continuing burn.
Tomas (CS Ops): We can apply a conservative quota: 200k tokens/day for org neptune-analytics on `/v1/embeddings/batch` for 72h, with an emergency bypass for their infra team. Will draft the rule.
Aidan (FinOps): Also recommend a temporary credit offset for the re-ingest volume and a renewal risk note. If this consumes >25% of their prepaid credits, mark renewal as "watch". I'll compute ASAP once we have baseline.
Rosa (SWE): Short-term code mitigation: add a distributed lock or per-job dedupe token. Example: `client.embed_batch(items, dedupe_key=job_uuid)` and exponential backoff on 409s. I'll add a one-liner to the SDK docs.
Priya (CSM): Baseline numbers: avg embeddings = 95k tokens/day. Current 7-day avg after spike = 280k. Projected 30-day at current rate ~8.4M tokens. I'll insert those numbers into the QBR deck and highlight the "unexpected reprocess" root cause.
Tomas (CS Ops): Action plan summary:
- Rosa: publish SDK snippet + quick PR to onboarding docs (ETA 24h)
- Tomas: apply quota rule and enable org-level bypass for devs (ETA 20m)
- Aidan: draft credit remediation + renewal impact calc (ETA EOD)
- Priya: update QBR slide + customer-facing note (ETA tomorrow)
Rosa (SWE): Implementing dedupe pattern in a patch now. Will also add telemetry to flag when a worker replays >3x.
alert-bot: Policy applied: quota `200k tokens/day` on route `/v1/embeddings/batch` for org neptune-analytics 2026-04-05T07:31:26Z.
Aidan (FinOps): Once quota is live, i'll run a savings projection. If the quota holds, estimated avoided spend over 30d = ~$6.5k (embedding unit pricing). Will add to renewal impact section.
Priya (CSM): I'll schedule a 45m "cost-proofing" enablement with their eng team to walk dedupe, idempotency, and batching best practices. Tomas please coordinate and capture their feedback.
Tomas (CS Ops): Scheduling now propose Thu 10:00 AM PT. Capturing notes to update our onboarding checklist so future migrations include preflight cost run.
Rosa (SWE): Small code snippet for the workshop:
```
# ensure dedupe per chunk
resp = client.embed_batch(chunks, dedupe_key=job_id)
if resp.status_code == 409:
    # backoff + check if job already processed
    check_job_state(job_id)
```
Priya (CSM): Thanks all. I'll add a slide that shows baseline vs actual, mitigation steps, and customer ask (credit + engineering enablement). Will post the draft deck link in this thread when ready.
Aidan (FinOps): Add me to the customer call for the QBR so I can walk the cost numbers and the remediation offer.
Tomas (CS Ops): Leaving thread open; will close after the enablement session and QBR prep. Ping here if anything else appears.
Priya (CSM): Copy will update with deck link and postmortem snippets after workshop.
